item.text: I’m focusing the evidence on the actual democratic mechanisms in 2022: election contestability, treatment of opposition/media, institutional restraint, and whether Marcos changed the inherited environment. I’ll keep the accepted set tight, but I’m first casting a wider net so the final dossier has both favorable and contrary material.
